questions.question: When Cornelius fell at Peter's feet to worship him, Peter let him stay down there. True or false?
When Peter visited Cornelius's house, what did he say he now truly understood about God?

answers.text: God hears only prayers in the temple

questions.question: In his message at Cornelius's house, Peter said who receives forgiveness of sins through Jesus' name?
While Peter was still telling the people in Cornelius's house about Jesus, what happened?

answers.text: The Holy Spirit fell on all who heard
The whole house began to shake
An angel appeared at the door
